name: harness
description: The team-architecture factory for Claude Code — a meta-skill (/harness:harness) that turns a domain description into an agent team and the skills they use, with six pre-defined team-architecture patterns (Pipeline, Fan-out/Fan-in, Expert Pool, Producer-Reviewer, Supervisor, Hierarchical Delegation). Also ships ready-made packaged harnesses you can run in place or eject into a repo — e.g. /harness:meta-plugin (repo-org loop), /harness:rust-port (full-parity Rust port), and /harness:feature-forge (design→implement→verify construction crew + Ralph loop), and /harness:bootstrap (one-command fresh-repo onboarding to hf + forge-loop), and /harness:planning-engineer (evidence-backed planning/architecture loop with governance/config and RED-test planning). Claude Code용 팀 아키텍처 팩토리: 도메인 한 문장을 에이전트 팀과 스킬 세트로 변환하는 메타 스킬.
